findings.message: infrastructure.md asserts docs/modules/persistence/overview.md and docs/modules/planned-items/overview.md were still unfilled skeleton documents (`[UNFILLED]` sentinel) at generation time, but both documents are fully generated with substantive content in the current docs tree, contradicting the claim and leaving stale unresolved markers for facts (database engine, session strategy) that are actually confirmed elsewhere in the tree.
